title: 彭博分析师：科技巨头AI支出面临宏观压力
speaker: Jasmine

segments.en: Happening in the crucible of tech earnings season, so we heard from Alphabet, that company talked about its spend on AI infrastructure.
segments.zh: 在科技财报季的熔炉中，我们听到了Alphabet谈论其在AI基础设施上的支出。

segments.en: I think if you look at those four major hyperscalers, it's something like $725 billion is what they're forecasted to be spending on this.
segments.zh: 我认为如果你看看那四大超大规模云服务商，它们预计在这方面支出约7250亿美元。

segments.en: How did our sense of that, our sense of the level of investment changes result of what Alphabet reported, and what are we going to learn this week from these other companies?
segments.zh: 我们对投资水平的看法因Alphabet的财报有何变化？本周我们将从其他公司了解到什么？

segments.en: Well, the playbook has changed for these companies and specifically their stocks.
segments.zh: 嗯，这些公司的策略已经改变，尤其是它们的股价。

segments.en: Normally your stock would be rewarded as a hyperscaler if you're spending more money on capital expenditures related to AI, but then what changed here, well a lot of that has to do with the macro.
segments.zh: 通常，作为超大规模云服务商，如果你在AI相关资本支出上投入更多，股价会得到回报。但变化在于，这很大程度上与宏观环境有关。

segments.en: I mean, y'all talk so much about oil prices spiking, just saw that this past week briefly above $100 for Brent prices, and also what does that mean for inflation in the path of rates.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你们经常谈论油价飙升，上周布伦特原油价格短暂突破100美元，这对通胀和利率路径意味着什么。

segments.en: because if these companies want to issue more stock issuance, but then if their stock is falling, that's a problem, so if you have to tap the debt markets, that's even more expensive.
segments.zh: 因为如果这些公司想增发股票，但股价却在下跌，那就有问题；如果不得不求助于债务市场，成本会更高。

segments.en: than what their earnings outlook would have been at the start of this year, so then something has to re-priced, but with that said, if you look at overall S&P 500 earning
segments.zh: 比年初的盈利展望更糟，所以某些东西必须重新定价。话虽如此，如果你看整体标普500盈利...
